CustomField.description: PacPoint-IC051419 - Created for BREG phase 1 This is used on the Timeframe field calculation. If today is greater than the Current Status Date/Time, count the months passed. If not, pass -1 value.
CustomField.formula:
IF( TODAY() >= DATEVALUE( CurrentStatusDateTime__c ),
( FLOOR(((TODAY() - DATEVALUE( CurrentStatusDateTime__c )) / 365 * 12)) ),
-1)
CustomField.label: Timeframe Count Months
